description: Maintainer-declared third-party model attribution for catalog display (Spec 025 non-inheritance). Not a substitute for reading each upstream LICENSE. commercial_use/redistribution 'allowed' means the upstream license is permissive for typical product use when attribution/notice conditions are met.

openai/whisper-tiny.notes: openai/whisper GitHub LICENSE is MIT; Hugging Face openai/whisper-tiny card metadata says Apache-2.0. Both primary sources; both permissive. Retain copyright + permission notice on redistribution. Weights packaged via Xenova/whisper-tiny ONNX (same checkpoint lineage).

snakers4/silero-vad.notes: MIT — verified against the repository LICENSE. Also embedded as the speech-presence pre-check inside audio.transcribe-speech@1.1.0.

dslim/distilbert-NER.notes: Apache-2.0 verified against Hugging Face cardData.license / license tag. Used by text.detect-entities and text.redact-entities.

sentence-transformers/paraphrase-MiniLM-.notes: Apache-2.0. Xenova ONNX conversion is also Apache-2.0 and references this base model.

minishlab/potion-base-32M.notes: MIT. Embedded by report.summarize-semantic (weights in-artifact; teacher BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 also MIT per publish evidence).
